ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, as amended by the Law of 25 March 2020 and subsequent instruments (AML/CFT Act); Law of 13 January 2019 establishing the Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE), as amended following the ECJ judgments of 22 November 2022 in joined cases C-37/20 and C-601/20 restricting public access to the register; Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended by the Law of 10 August 2016 and the Law of 23 September 2020 (SARL governed by Articles 710-1 et seq.); CSSF Regulation 12-02 of 14 December 2012; CSSF Circular 18/698.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copies of the passports of all ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) and natural-person managers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent civil-status authority of the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for all Hague Convention contracting states OR Consular Legalization for non-apostille states; certification must be fresh within 3 months prior to the notarial deed of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Extract or certificate of good standing of each corporate direct shareholder (foreign entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official company registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization authenticating the company-registry seal and authorized signatory

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney appointing the incorporation agent and the Luxembourg notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization of the grantors' signatures; alternatively executed in authentic form before the Luxembourg notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or municipal attestation) of managers and UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Municipal authority or licensed utility provider of the residence country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization for official attestations; sworn certification acceptable for private utility bills

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified French (or German/Luxembourgish) translation of the constitutional instruments and clearance extracts
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Sworn translator registered with the Luxembourg Superior Court (Cour supérieure de justice)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Translator's certification accepted by the RCS and the notary where the underlying source document has been apostilled or consularly legalized

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, managers and shareholders against: (i) Luxembourg Financial Intelligence Unit (Cellule de Renseignement Financier - CRF) and CSSF guidance on politically exposed persons (PEPs) under FATF international standards; (ii) the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; (iii) the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (iv) the OFAC SDN list, which is mandatory for USD-denominated Swift LC and TT wire payment rails; and (v) domestic Luxembourg restrictive measures. Negative screening results must be evidenced by timestamped reports archived for a minimum of five years. Enhanced due diligence (EDD) is mandatory for any PEP, high-risk third-country exposure, or beneficial owner presenting opaque nominee or trust structures, including submission of source-of-funds and source-of-wealth documentation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) operated by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - electronic one-stop-shop portal at www.lbr.lu, including the eRegistration and MyGuichet.lu channel
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be written in Latin characters; names originating in non-Latin scripts (e.g., Chinese characters) must be transliterated into a Latin-script spelling for the RCS entry. The legal-form suffix 'Société à Responsabilité Limitée' or the abbreviation 'SARL' is mandatory and must be appended to the distinctive firm name. Names may be expressed in French, German, Luxembourgish, or any language using the Latin alphabet, provided they are not contrary to public order or good morals, are not misleading or deceptive, do not falsely suggest a regulated activity, and are distinguishable from all existing RCS-registered names and from trademarks protected in Luxembourg.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque / Bank (requires prior CSSF banking licence clearance)
Assurance / Insurance (requires prior Commissariat aux Assurances approval)
SICAV / FCP / SIF / RAIF / SICAR (regulated-fund regime clearance by the CSSF is a precondition)
Société de gestion / Asset Management (CSSF authorisation as a management company required)
État / State / National / Gouvernement (prior ministerial authorisation)
Université / University (approval of the Ministry of Education required)
Audi / Réviseur d'entreprises / Auditor (reserved for CSSF-audited professionals)
Trust (term reserved under international trust and fiduciary conventions)
Chambre de Commerce / Chamber of Commerce (statutorily reserved denomination)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a negative name-clearance decision by the RCS: (i) the applicant shall file a reasoned electronic re-examination request with Luxembourg Business Registers within 15 calendar days of the refusal, proposing up to three alternative name variants that remedy the stated conflict (submission channel: RCS@lbr.lu with the reservation reference); (ii) the applicant may request a supplementary reservation period of up to 30 days where prior rights are being resolved, by producing a trademark coexistence letter, the consent of the conflicting trademark proprietor, or evidence of withdrawal of competing pending applications; (iii) if the administrative re-examination is unsuccessful, the applicant may lodge a formal administrative appeal (recours) before the Luxembourg District Court (Tribunal d'arrondissement de Luxembourg) within the statutory time limit, in accordance with the general provisions of the New Code of Civil Procedure and the relevant provisions of the Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies; legal counsel review is strongly recommended for any refusal based on an alleged infringement of prior trademark rights.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A registered office in Luxembourg is mandatory and must be declared to the RCS together with the actual central administration seat (siège de l'administration centrale). A virtual office is permissible solely through a CSSF-licensed and supervised domiciliation agent (agréé à la domiciliation). For the present ISIC 1050 aseptic UHT oat-milk manufacturing project, a virtual office is acceptable only as the legal seat for registration and correspondence purposes and does not satisfy the economic-substance requirement for a production plant. The SARL must maintain tangible presence, namely a physical production facility, raw-material storage, quality-control laboratory, locally employed staff with employment contracts, and operating equipment, at a physical site in Luxembourg or another EU manufacturing location; failure to do so exposes the company to recharacterization of its seat, denial of Luxembourg tax treaty benefits, and potential VAT registration challenges by the Administration de l'Enregistrement, des Domaines et de la TVA (AEDT).
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate quantified risk: estimated 30-45% probability of an unannounced on-site inspection within the first 12 months of operation. Primary triggers: (i) RCS verification of the registered seat upon incorporation; (ii) AEDT VAT desk audits of a newly formed SARL with foreign shareholders; (iii) Administration des contributions directes (ACD) economic-substance reviews for cross-border manufacturing structures; and (iv) CSSF on-site inspections performed at the licensed domiciliation agent rather than at the company's own premises. The inspection probability increases where a virtual office is combined with an opaque financing or dividend-repatriation structure.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name clearance and priority reservation (RCS via LBR)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory RCS tariff for online name reservation (approx. EUR 30-60)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial deed of incorporation (authentic act) including notary emoluments and disbursements
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg notary public (mandatory authentic instrument for SARL)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial emoluments tariff (tarif des notaires) and prevailing market benchmark: EUR 1,200-2,500 for a standard non-regulated SARL

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration of the SARL in the RCS (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory RCS filing fee schedule (approx. EUR 200-350)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Official legal notice publication in RESA (Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations)
Filing of the beneficial ownership declaration in the RBE (Register of Beneficial Owners)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed AML screening data provider / professional support firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: USD 900-1,500 per entity per annum for continuous screening and archived reports

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague apostille and/or consular legalization of UBO signatures, corporate extracts and powers of attorney
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs (Luxembourg legalizations section) and relevant foreign consulates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translators listed with the Luxembourg Superior Court
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: EUR 60-100 per certified page

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External legal counsel admitted to the Luxembourg bar (barreau de Luxembourg)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended (Loi modifiée du 10 août 1915 concernant les sociétés commerciales); SARL regime: Articles 182-1 to 183-1; legal personality acquired upon registration under Article 38; modernizations introduced by the Law of 23 July 2016 on the modernisation of company law.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), Luxembourg City; electronic filing via www.lbr.lu / eJustice portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Deed of Incorporation (Acte constitutif / Statuts), executed as a notarial deed or a private deed (acte sous seing privé) for cash-only capital, then filed electronically with the RCS for registration and publication in the RESA.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: SARL minimum share capital is EUR 12,000, fully subscribed and fully paid up at incorporation; cash contributions must be deposited in a blocked account with a Luxembourg credit institution or the Caisse de Consignation and released only upon RCS registration; in-kind contributions require a statutory auditor's report unless exempt under the de minimis thresholds.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporators and sole subscriber hereby subscribe, at par, to the full issued share capital of EUR 12,000, representing 100 shares of EUR 120 each, and that the subscribed funds have been deposited into a blocked account pending company registration. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the draft Articles of Association tabled before this meeting are approved as the company's governing charter, and that the registered office is fixed at 01, Rue de l'Eau, L-1011 Luxembourg City. FURTHER RESOLVED, that [Full Manager Name] is appointed sole manager (gérant) with full legal and banking authority, and that pre-registration formalities, including RCS filing, are delegated to the retained legal counsel.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – RCS online consultation portal and a Luxembourg notary of the Chambre des Notaires du Luxembourg.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Run an online availability search on the RCS database and obtain a non-conflicting name opinion; instruct counsel to prepare the draft Articles of Association (statuts), including corporate object covering aseptic UHT oat-milk manufacturing and packaging, registered office, capital structure, and management powers; reserve the draft for notarial review.
required_dossiers: RCS name-availability search report
Draft Articles of Association (statuts)
Passport copies and proof of address of founding shareholders
Draft manager appointment consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name conflicts with an existing registration, promptly file a substitute name application with the LBR; a refused registration can be appealed to the Luxembourg District Court (Tribunal d'arrondissement) within two months.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg credit institution or Post Luxembourg Centre de Chèques Postaux; alternatively the Caisse de Consignation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary corporate account in the name of the company in formation, deposit the full EUR 12,000 share capital, and obtain the bank's blocking certificate (certificat de blocage) confirming that the funds are unavailable until the RCS registration certificate is produced; the certificate must be addressed to the notary or the RCS.
required_dossiers: Account-opening bank forms and KYC file
Passports and residence proof of beneficial owners
Draft Articles of Association
Bank certificate of capital blocking
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the chosen bank delays or refuses onboarding, instruct a second Luxembourg bank or the Caisse de Consignation; the blocking certificate may be re-issued within 1-2 business days upon complete KYC documentation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary (notaire) for the notarial deed, or authorized counsel for a private deed; corporate share register maintained by the gérant.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Finalize the statuts, coordinate signature of the incorporation deed before the notary (recommended) or as a private deed for cash contributions, attach the bank blocking certificate, subscribe and allot the shares, adopt the first board resolution, appoint the gérant, and have the deed legalized/registered for stamp-duty purposes; if in-kind contributions exist, annex the réviseur d'entreprises agréé valuation report.
required_dossiers: Final Articles of Association
Notarial or private deed of incorporation
Bank capital-blocking certificate
Share-subscription list / shareholders' register
Statutory auditor's report on in-kind contributions (if applicable)
First board resolution / manager acceptance deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies missing documentation, cure the gaps in 3-5 business days by obtaining the missing KYC or auditor report; re-execution of the deed may be done with a simple corrigerende act (rectification act) without full re-subscription.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration Filing with the Luxembourg Business Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), electronic filing desk (eJustice/LBR portal).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the registration application within one month of the deed date via the LBR secure e-filing portal; attach the certified deed, proof of registered office, identity and signature cards of the gérant, and the paid stamp-duty evidence; the RCS issues the certificate of registration (extrait du RCS) upon approval, at which point the company acquires legal personality.
required_dossiers: RCS registration application (formulaire électronique)
Certified copy of the incorporation deed
Certified French/German translation of the deed (if drafted in another language)
Lease or domiciliation agreement proving registered office address
Identity documents and specimen signatures of the gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a query (défaut) or requests supplementary documentation, respond within the stated cure period (usually 1 month); an RCS refusal to register can be challenged before the Luxembourg District Court in its non-contentious jurisdiction (procédure gracieuse) within two months.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the Electronic Compendium of Companies and Associations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RESA – Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (official electronic compendium), managed by the Luxembourg Ministry of Justice via LBR.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon registration, the RCS automatically transmits the incorporation data to the RESA for official publication; verify the published extract, order certified copies for banking and commercial counterparties, and distribute the RCS registration number and legal-form references to the company's officers.
required_dossiers: Registration data sheet transmitted by the RCS
Certified extract from the RCS (extrait du registre)
Publication receipt from the RESA
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the published RESA text contains errors, file a rectification request with the RCS; the RCS corrects the record and re-publishes within 3-5 business days at no additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Beneficial Owner Register Filing and Governance Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE), electronic filing space.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within one month of RCS registration, file the mandatory beneficial-ownership declaration (RBE) declaring all natural persons holding, directly or indirectly, more than 25% of the share capital or voting rights; simultaneously open the corporate statutory registers (share register, minutes register, contracts register) and issue the gérant's bank mandate and operational powers.
required_dossiers: RBE declaration form
Beneficial-owner identification documents (passports/IDs)
Corporate chart and shareholders' register evidencing ownership structure
Minutes of the first general meeting / board meeting
Bank mandate for the gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RBE declaration is queried or rejected, correct the filing online within 15 days; late or inaccurate filings are subject to administrative fines and publication sanctions under the Law of 13 January 2019, which can be cured by voluntary correction before enforcement.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Administration luxembourgeoise vétérinaire et alimentaire (ALVA) – competent food-safety authority for the approval of food business establishments, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Viticulture and Rural Development and the municipal administration of the commune where the plant is located.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Approval of food business establishment under Regulation (EC) No 852/2004 (agrément sanitaire ALVA), supplemented by the municipal business-establishment permit (autorisation d'établissement) and the environmental operating permit (permis d'exploitation) issued under the Environmental Protection Law.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement – Ministry of the Environment, Climate and Sustainable Development (Ministère de l'Environnement, du Climat et du Développement durable).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category II / EIA Notice (notification) for an aseptic plant-based milk manufacturing facility with daily finished-product capacity between 5 and 500 tonnes; a Full EIA Report (évaluation des incidences sur l'environnement) is mandatory where capacity exceeds 500 tonnes/day or where the plant is located in a protected or sensitive zone (Natura 2000, water-catchment area).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Industrial wastewater discharge thresholds under the Luxembourg water-management regime (Law of 19 December 2008 and related Grand-Ducal Regulations): COD ≤ 125 mg/L, BOD5 ≤ 25 mg/L, TSS ≤ 35 mg/L, pH 6.5–9.0, total nitrogen ≤ 10 mg/L, total phosphorus ≤ 1 mg/L for direct surface-water discharge, or pre-treatment to municipal-sewer standards before discharge; VOC and odor emissions subject to BAT conclusions for the Food, Drink and Milk Industries under Directive 2010/75/EU with ≥ 90% abatement for solvent emissions; solid-waste handling and recovery quotas per the waste-management plan, including wet sludge and packaging-waste segregation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certification and pre-operational inspection by the Corps grand-ducal d'incendie et de secours (CGIDS) and the commune's fire-prevention service; structural load and building-stability inspection certificate from an accredited technical control bureau (e.g. Secolux or Socotec); occupational health and safety clearance from the Inspection du travail et des mines (ITM) covering workplace risk assessment, machinery directives, noise exposure, and the establishment notification before commencement of operations; food-safety premia require ALVA sanitary inspection and HACCP plan validation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) for corporate income tax; Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT, registration duties and excise duties; unified e-services portal: https://myguichet.lu (LuxTrust authentication); customs and export clearance: https://plda.etat.lu (Portail Logistique et Douanes Administratives); Luxembourg Business Registers (www.lbr.lu).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: incorporate SARL and obtain RCS matricule (11-digit national business number) from the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (Registry of Commerce and Companies, RCS/LBR). Step 2: file VAT registration Form 645 electronically via MyGuichet with the AEDT, using the matricule, articles of association, business licence (autorisation d'établissement), and proof of place of business; the AEDT assigns the LU VAT identification number (LU + 11 digits). Step 3: non-resident shareholders require a domestic registered office and a local manager (gérant) but no minimum residence requirement; a foreign enterprise without a local establishment that performs taxable supplies in Luxembourg must likewise obtain a LU VAT ID from the first euro of turnover, without benefiting from the small-business franchise.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; SARL is an opaque resident capital company (société de capitaux) subject to corporate income tax (17% on profits above EUR 200,000; 15% on the first EUR 175,000 with a 31% marginal bridge rate), 7% unemployment solidarity surcharge and municipal business tax (6.75% in Luxembourg City), giving an aggregate standard rate of 24.94% for the UHT oat-milk plant; resident SARL taxable on worldwide income; no tax-exempt manufacturing zone; non-resident shareholders are taxed in Luxembourg only via 15% dividend withholding tax (reduced or eliminated under EU directives and treaties); not eligible for pass-through treatment.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box regime exists under Luxembourg law. Available elections: (i) fiscal unity / integral tax consolidation (intégration fiscale) under Art. 164bis LIR for ≥95% directly or indirectly held resident entities; (ii) IP box election under Art. 50ter LIR exempting 80% of qualifying IP income; (iii) participation exemption election for 100% dividend and capital-gain relief on qualifying holdings of ≥10% (or ≥EUR 1.2M acquisition price for dividends / ≥EUR 6M for gains) held for ≥12 months; (iv) VAT grouping election (assujetti unique) under Art. 61bis of the VAT Law; hybrid mismatch scenarios are mandatorily neutralised under ATAD implementing Articles 168bis-168ter LIR, leaving no elective hybrid-mismatch planning.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (TVA - Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée) in accordance with EU Council Directive 2006/112/EC, implemented by the Luxembourg VAT Law of 12 February 1979 (loi TVA).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 annual turnover (excl. VAT) for the domestic small-business franchise under Art. 57 loi TVA; no threshold for non-established taxable persons or for traders making intra-Community acquisitions/supplies nor for exporters — mandatory VAT registration from the first euro of taxable turnover; the SARL manufacturing and exporting UHT oat milk must register as an ordinary taxable person and cannot use the franchise.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction control, or digital stamping regime exists in Luxembourg; e-invoicing in B2B is permitted with counterparty consent; B2G e-invoicing to central government via PEPPOL is mandatory since April 2019; VAT returns (monthly/quarterly), EC Sales Lists and Intrastat declarations must be filed electronically through MyGuichet/ACD; the EU VAT in the Digital Age (ViDA) reform will impose mandatory structured e-invoicing and digital reporting requirements for intra-EU B2B supplies from 2030, at which point Luxembourg will deploy transaction-level clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies at 0% to: (a) definitive export of UHT oat-milk products from Luxembourg to non-EU destinations under Art. 44 loi TVA, provided the goods physically leave EU territory and the exporter retains transport evidence; (b) intra-Community supplies of goods to an EU VAT-registered customer under Art. 43 loi TVA, subject to valid customer VAT number, dispatch to another Member State, and EC Sales List filing; ancillary transport, packaging and bottling services provided by the plant in connection with exported goods are also zero-rated; the SARL must hold regular VAT registration, complete commercial books, and may claim periodic VAT refunds of input VAT allocable to zero-rated exports.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Electronic export declaration (EXS/Single Administrative Document) filed via the Luxembourg PLDA customs portal with MRN (Movement Reference Number)
Bill of Lading, CMR consignment note, or Airway Bill evidencing physical departure from EU customs territory
Commercial invoice, packing list, and Incoterms-based sale contract
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT MT103 credit advice proving payment of export proceeds
For intra-EU zero-rating: ECB validation output of customer's EU VAT number and the recapitulative statement (EC Sales List) submitted to AEDT
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The AEDT may claw back the zero-rated treatment and reassess VAT at the 17% standard rate if the documentary bundle is incomplete, inconsistent, or fraudulent, with statutory default interest on the additional assessment; administrative surcharges under the General Tax Law (Abgabenordnung) add up to 50% of the evaded tax for negligence and up to 100% for wilful evasion; criminal VAT fraud (Art. 24 loi TVA and AO Arts. 397-405) is punishable by imprisonment of one to five years and fines up to EUR 250,000, with joint and several liability of the SARL's managers; the limitation period of assessment is 5 years, extended to 10 years in cases of fraud.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL) as the National Central Bank of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg; the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) is the competent financial-sector regulator with no separate foreign-exchange administration.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Luxembourg is a Eurozone member and applies full euro-denominated current-account and capital-account convertibility under Article 63 TFEU on the free movement of capital and payments. There are no exchange-control permits, no tariff-style currency restrictions, and no approval gate for cross-border profit remittance. Dividend withholding tax is the only material fiscal friction: the domestic Luxembourg rate is 15%, reduced to 0% for qualifying EU corporate shareholders under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive and to lower rates under bilateral tax treaties. Operational hurdles are therefore tax/substance-related rather than currency-related: the SARL must demonstrate substance, transfer-pricing compliance, and proper beneficial-ownership documentation before distributions and shareholder-loan repayments are executed.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Luxembourg imposes no statutory export-proceeds surrender obligation and no mandatory conversion ratio. Export receivables in EUR, USD, GBP, or other permitted currencies may be retained in full at the SARL's bank accounts. The only compliance overlay is statistical: individual cross-border payments of EUR 12,500 or more are captured in the BCL balance-of-payments direct reporting system, and the SARL must maintain supporting invoices and SWIFT/SEPA records to substantiate the economic purpose and the correct BOP classification of each flow.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Epargne de l'Etat (BCEE)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Accounts (Comptes Annuels) - filing and publication of the balance sheet, profit and loss account, and annexed notes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) acting for the Registre de Commerce et des Societes (RCS); publication in the Recueil electronique des societes et associations (RESA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months after the close of the financial year; for a calendar-year SARL the filing is due by 31 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a court injunction and fines of EUR 600 to EUR 2,500 under Article 179 of the Luxembourg Companies Law 1915; publication costs are recoverable against the SARL; persistent non-filing leads to administrative strike-off from the RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Owner Confirmation (RBE) - annual validation that the Register of Beneficial Owners and shareholding schedule remain accurate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre des Beneficiaires Effectifs (RBE) operated by the Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At least once per calendar year; confirmation must be completed no later than one month after the anniversary of the initial RBE registration; any share transfer or change of beneficial owner requires an updated filing within 30 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines from EUR 200 to EUR 2,000 for missing the annual confirmation; intentionally false declarations attract criminal sanctions of up to EUR 25,000 and up to six months' imprisonment; repeat non-compliance may result in RCS strike-off procedures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Return (Form 700) including the Municipal Business Tax (impot commercial communal) declaration and the tax annexes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) - Luxembourg direct tax administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due by 31 March of the year following the calendar year; an automatic extension to 31 December applies when the return is filed electronically through the ACD e-filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing administrative fines up to EUR 2,500; late-payment interest accrues at 0.6% per month on unpaid corporate income tax and municipal business tax; fiscal recovery measures including bank garnishment apply for extended defaults.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Net Wealth Tax Return (Form 501) - annual declaration of the SARL's net taxable assets
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due by 31 March of the year following the financial year, aligned with the corporate income tax package
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to EUR 2,500; interest accrues monthly at 0.6% on unpaid net wealth tax; continued non-filing permits tax assessment by estimation and enforcement through the state recovery office.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A SARL must appoint an independent statutory auditor (reviseur d'entreprises) when it exceeds two of three criteria: balance sheet total above EUR 4.4 million, net turnover above EUR 8.8 million, or an average workforce above 50 employees. A contractual audit may also be required by lenders where bank financing exceeds EUR 250,000.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP (Lux GAAP) as codified by the Law of 10 August 1915 on commercial companies and the Grand-Ducal Regulation of 17 June 2010 on annual accounts; EU-endorsed IFRS is permitted only for consolidated accounts; micro-entities may apply the simplified micro-entity balance sheet and notes format.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Law of 13 January 2019, the SARL must confirm the RBE-listed beneficial owners at least once per year, due within one month after the anniversary of the initial declaration; any SARL share transfer requires an updated register entry, a notarized or manager-signed transfer acknowledgement, and an RBE amendment filed within 30 days. The annual confirmation certifies that the Register of Members, the RBE extract, and the annual shareholding schedule are fully aligned.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Shareholders (Registre des actions nominatives)
Register of Managers and Statutory Appointments
Minute Book of Shareholder and Manager Decisions

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% aggregate for Luxembourg City (FY 2024/2025): 17% corporate income tax (CIT) (15% on the first €175,000 of taxable income) + 7% solidarity surcharge on CIT + 6.75% municipal business tax (ICC).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Participation exemption (Art. 166 LIR): 100% CIT/ICC exemption for qualifying dividend income and capital gains (≥10% shareholding or acquisition cost ≥€6M, 12-month holding for dividends and 24-month for capital gains); IP Box: 80% exemption of net IP income from patents and copyrighted software, yielding ≈4.99% effective rate; R&D investment tax credit under the 2021 Investment Tax Credit Act with enhanced rates for clean-tech aseptic UHT oat-milk packaging innovation; minimum net wealth tax of €3,214.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited carryforward duration; annual offset of carried-forward losses is capped at 75% of taxable income exceeding €17,640 (Art. 163 LIR).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulaire 2 (combined CIT and municipal business tax annual return) and Formulaire 4 (net wealth tax return) filed with the Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD) via the e-Tax / MyGuichet.lu electronic filing portal using LuxTrust secure authentication; transfer-pricing schedules are annexed to the same filing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (calendar year or commercial fiscal year); VAT and wage withholding declarations run separately on monthly/quarterly cycles.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Statutory deadline: 31 March of the year following the fiscal year (Art. 164 LIR); e-filing returns are administratively accepted through 30 June, and extensions of up to 31 December are commonly granted upon ACD reminders; final assessed tax is payable within three months of notification of the assessment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company fiscal identification number, Luxembourg RCS registration number, legal form (Société à Responsabilité Limitée), registered office address, VAT identification number and business activity code (ISIC 1050).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident managers must authenticate with LuxTrust and appoint a Luxembourg tax representative (mandataire fiscal) authorised to sign and endorse the e-filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box A – Résultat comptable avant impôts
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory net profit or loss before income taxes per the annual accounts prepared under Luxembourg GAAP, including production revenue, raw oat purchases, tolling costs, depreciation of the UHT plant and packaging machinery.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Submit the audited Luxembourg statutory accounts with a French/English reconciliation schedule; no conversion to foreign GAAP is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box B – Réintégrations et déductions fiscales
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reintegrate non-deductible expenses (income taxes, fines, penalties, excessive director remuneration, 50% of certain entertainment expenses) and deduct qualifying exempt dividends, IP Box income, investment tax credits and prior-year losses within the statutory cap.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain a detailed workpaper trail in French or English evidencing each reintegration and deduction; the ACD may reject any claim lacking contemporaneous documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Annexe – Transfer pricing schedule (opérations avec sociétés associées)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Schedule of all related-party transactions: oat-supply agreements, aseptic process royalties, intra-group management fees, intercompany financing, and sales of UHT oat-milk cartons to group distribution companies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The foreign parent must supply the Master File group chart and global TP policy; the Luxembourg SARL must attach a Local File when the statutory threshold is exceeded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box C – Impôt sur le revenu des collectivités / ICC / IFT recap
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of CIT, solidarity surcharge, municipal business tax, net wealth tax, available tax credits (including foreign tax credits) and the resulting final balance payable or refundable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign shareholders have no direct credit against the SARL's CIT balance; dividend withholding tax is an entirely separate obligation arising only at distribution.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late or non-filing: administrative fines of €25–€2,500 per infraction, a 10% tax surcharge on ex officio assessments (taxation d'office) which may disregard claimed deductions, and monthly late-payment interest of 0.6%–0.8%; persistent default triggers garnishment, asset attachment and bank embargo against the company.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Qualifying EU/EEA parents holding at least 10% of the SARL's capital and committing to a 12-month holding period may claim exemption at source through the Parent-Subsidiary Directive (EU 2011/96), avoiding withholding entirely. For treaty-based relief, the payer must withhold the domestic 15%, and the non-resident beneficial owner applies to the ACD for refund using: a Form 22-bis Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the home jurisdiction, board resolutions, share register extract, and a beneficial ownership declaration; most Luxembourg DTAs reduce the rate to 5% for shareholdings of at least 10%, and refund processing normally takes 6–12 months.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory and 0% domestic rate for cross-border royalties (including aseptic UHT process IP) and debt interest outbound from Luxembourg; Luxembourg does not impose withholding tax on outbound royalty or interest payments, so DTA rates are effectively nil notwithstanding treaty language reserving a source right.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File: mandatory for a Luxembourg entity whose annual net turnover exceeds €4,000,000 or whose aggregate related-party transactions exceed €1,000,000 (Art. 56bis LIR as amended by the Law of 28 December 2018); Master File and Country-by-Country Report: mandatory for MNE groups with consolidated group revenue of €750,000,000 or more, with a separate CbC notification filed to the ACD.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Luxembourg has no standalone Economic Substance Regulation (ESR) statute, but the ACD applies the EU ATAD GAAR, Art. 6 AO abuse-of-law doctrine, and the ACD's 2017 substance guidance: the UHT oat-milk manufacturing SARL must demonstrate local premises, qualified full-time employees (plant operators, QA engineers, logistics staff), active management decisions taken in Luxembourg, a Luxembourg bank account, and genuine commercial and operational risk. Real plant assets, utility flows, and purchase/offtake contracts executed in Luxembourg provide strong substance; a hollow conduit lacking personnel and physical operations would be recharacterised and denied treaty and Directive benefits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion – False or incomplete CIT return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately understating UHT plant revenues, fabricating supplier invoices, omitting intra-group oat supply contracts, or shifting profit to a low-tax related party without arm's-length consideration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fine up to €10,000 and imprisonment of 8 days to 5 years (Art. 217 AO); civil reassessment adds the evaded tax, a 10% surcharge, monthly default interest of 0.6%–0.8%, and taxation d'office disallowing undocumented deductions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Gérants and administrators are personally and solidarily liable for the company's resulting tax debt where wilful fault is established; consequences include seizure of personal assets, disqualification from board mandates, travel bans, and up to 5 years' imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to prepare and file the Local File above the €4M/€1M thresholds, applying unjustified TNMM margins, paying unremunerated management fees, or concluding undocumented intercompany loans carrying non-arm's-length interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Up to 10% surcharge on the ACD transfer-pricing adjustment; denial of interest and expense deductibility; potential double taxation; repeated breaches are escalated to the ACD anti-abuse unit and can trigger criminal tax proceedings.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign incomplete TP documentation may be held jointly and severally liable for reassessed corporate taxes under ACD enforcement practice, notwithstanding the SARL's limited liability shield.
